SCHEMAS_ENABLED = False

OWNER = "lh-1/dbo"

SOURCE_TABLES = ["dim_customer", "dim_date", "dim_product", "fact_sales"]

def col(name):

SELECT

    d1.[customer_sk] AS [dim_customer_customer_sk],
    d1.[customer_bk] AS [dim_customer_customer_bk],
    d1.[customer_name] AS [dim_customer_customer_name],
    d1.[country] AS [dim_customer_country],
    d2.[date_key] AS [dim_date_date_key],
    d2.[full_date] AS [dim_date_full_date],
    d2.[year] AS [dim_date_year],
    d2.[month] AS [dim_date_month],
    d3.[product_sk] AS [dim_product_product_sk],
    d3.[product_bk] AS [dim_product_product_bk],
    d3.[product_name] AS [dim_product_product_name],
    d3.[category] AS [dim_product_category]
FROM [dbo].[fact_sales] AS f
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[dim_customer] AS d1 ON f.[customer_sk] = d1.[customer_sk]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[dim_date] AS d2 ON f.[order_date_key] = d2.[date_key]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[dim_product] AS d3 ON f.[product_sk] = d3.[product_sk]
